items.title: JSW Steel’s Q1 profit soars 2x YoY on robust topline growth
items.description: JSW Steel's profit more than doubled year-on-year to 4,696 crore in the June quarter. Robust revenue growth and higher volumes aided the company's strong financial performance. Consolidated revenue from operations rose around ten percent on year to 47,364 crore. Total expenses grew less than four percent on year, which helped profitability. The company's net debt also saw a significant reduction during the period.

items.title: Reliance Retail's Q1 profit drops 14% YoY but revenue rises 8%
items.description: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a fourteen percent profit decline last quarter. Revenue from operations grew eight point two percent year-on-year. Investments in e-commerce and digital infrastructure pressured operating margins. The company aims to double operating Ebitda over three years. Reliance Retail expanded its store network to over twenty thousand locations.

items.title: RIL's Q1 operational revenue hits milestone with 25% YoY jump
items.description: Reliance Industries saw a twenty-five percent profit drop in the June quarter.  Revenue from operations increased twenty-five percent, crossing three lakh crore rupees.  Reliance Retail's net profit declined fourteen percent while revenue grew eight percent.  The oil-to-chemicals segment revenue rose over thirty percent amid market volatility.  Jio Platforms reported its first profit decline due to 5G asset capitalization.
